svg.text: Compare A: after settlement with B: on Finish. Six cases; neither timing is approved.
Source read at 3e45abdc · not a runtime capture
Receipt medium and language are currently in Pay.
AUTHOR RECOMMENDATION · A + explicit slip choice after success
Receipt failure never means pay again. Issuance does not wait for a delivery choice.
A1 · One payer at the counter
Final receipt delivery is asked later.
Eligible paper only. Not an invoice.
Ask the counter operator who took payment.
Then return to the new basket; table Finish is separate.
No operator / no finisher: keep pending; no zone fallback.
B1 · One payer at the counter
Final receipt delivery is asked later.
Eligible paper only. Not an invoice.
Payment is complete. Wait for an explicit Finish.
Whoever finishes answers, possibly on another device.
Save the choice, then run the normal Finish checks.
No operator / no finisher: keep pending; no zone fallback.
A2 · Last of three guests at a table
Final receipt delivery is asked later.
Eligible paper only. Not an invoice.
Ask the operator on this handheld or counter.
Delivery address only; identity is already fixed.
Return to the paid table view; Finish is separate.
No operator / no finisher: keep pending; no zone fallback.

A3 · An edit settles the bill
Full-invoice identity is resolved before this save.
Final receipt delivery is asked later.
Earlier €10.00 slip stays unchanged; no new slip.
Ask the editor after the successful save.
No paper or email. The invoice stays issued.
Return to the editor; retain this bill’s receipt status.
No operator / no finisher: keep pending; no zone fallback.

Slips: cash and eligible readers only; no manual-card slip or duplicate reader paper.
